candidates.sentence: In Congress, I am working to ease the cost of living, cut taxes, and reduce our national debt.
Tony Vargas never mentions that he proposed the largest tax increase in NE’s history.
I believe immigration is an essential part of our nation’s history and our economic growth, but it has to be done legally.
In Congress, I am backing legislation to secure the border and reform our broken immigration system.
HR 2 – the Secure the Border Act of 2023
